d: As the world's largest family of luxury hotels, we all take great pride in being genuine ambassadors of the InterContinental® brand.

At InterContinental Muscat, we are passionate about delivering True Luxury—through genuine care, refined service, and meaningful guest connections. Our restaurants are at the heart of the guest experience, where first impressions set the tone for unforgettable dining moments.

We are looking for a friendly, attentive, and professional Food & Beverage Attendant to ensure high-quality service in our dining outlets. The ideal candidate will deliver exceptional guest experiences by providing efficient service, anticipating needs, and maintaining the highest standards of hospitality.
q: Previous experience in food & beverage service in hotels, restaurants, or serviced residences is preferred.
Ability to work in a fast-paced environment and flexible shifts, including weekends and public holidays.
Knowledge of food and beverage standards, hygiene, and safety practices.

r: Guest Service: Welcoming guests, taking their orders, and ensuring they have a memorable dining experience.
Order Management: Accurately relaying orders to the kitchen and bar, and delivering food and beverages promptly.
Table Setup and Maintenance: Arranging table settings, maintaining cleanliness, and ensuring tables are ready for the next guests.
Food and Beverage Preparation: Assisting in the preparation of beverages like coffee and cocktails, and sometimes helping with basic food prep.
Inventory Control: Managing and restocking food and beverage supplies as needed.
Payment Handling: Processing guest payments accurately and ensuring all transactions are handled properly.
Health and Safety Compliance: Following all health and safety regulations to ensure a safe dining environment.
Problem Resolution: Addressing any guest complaints or issues in a professional and courteous manner.

d: We're looking for a Talent Specialist to join our team at Ziina. This is a hands-on, full-cycle recruiting role: you'll own your pipelines from first outreach to accepted offer, working with teams across the business. You'll run outbound-first searches in competitive markets, with AI tooling built into every step of the process. This is an exciting opportunity for someone who thrives in a growing startup environment, brings strong talent acquisition and operational excellence, and is energized by contributing to a modern, forward-thinking talent function.
r: Run end-to-end recruiting for assigned roles, from intake to accepted offer, with a consistent, high-quality process across every team you hire for
Deliver a candidate experience we're proud of at every stage
Partner with hiring managers to understand what their team actually needs and turn it into a clear, realistic role profile
Help hiring managers and interviewers evaluate well: clear scorecards, useful feedback, calibrated decisions
Contribute to recommendations for senior leadership and cross-functional stakeholders
Track your pipeline metrics, notice what is not working, and improve your own hiring outcomes based on data
Keep recruiting systems accurate and up to date (ATS, automations, workflows), and when you see something not working in our recruiting setup, even outside your own roles, propose a solution
Manage job boards, agencies, and other external recruitment partners day to day, and track whether they deliver value
Look beyond your own roles: bring ideas on employer brand, candidate experience, and how we hire as a company, even where you don't own the outcome
To succeed in this role, you likely
Have 3+ years of full-cycle recruiting experience, including experience in a startup environment
Are a strong sourcer, comfortable when outbound is the main channel
Are comfortable using data and analytics tools to drive insights and decisions
Understand various TA systems and have supported process optimization, including ATS management and recruitment automation tools
Have experience collaborating with cross-functional teams, including engineering, product, and operations, to align recruitment strategy with business priorities
Operate with a detail-oriented mindset and can manage competing priorities in a fast-moving, cross-functional environment
Have significantly contributed to a Talent Acquisition function from the ground up, establishing processes, playbooks, and scalable systems
You've closed senior or niche roles through outbound sourcing, in markets where inbound doesn't work
AI tools are already part of your daily sourcing and screening work, and you know where the human judgment stays
You've built a dashboard, report, or process improvement that your team actually adopted and still uses
Ownership is your default: when something blocks your work, you fix it or find the person who can, without waiting to be asked
